hero.title: Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering in Spain for Indians

overview: Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering in Spain for Indian Students offers Indian students a chance to gain expertise in machine design, manufacturing, thermodynamics, materials science, robotics, and industrial automation. The Spanish undergraduate engineering programs combine theoretical fundamentals and practical learning through laboratories, technical projects and engineering applications.

sections.title: Why go to Spain to study Mechanical Engineering?
sections.lead: Study Mechanical Engineering in Spain The students will be able to acquire the skills necessary for the design, analysis, manufacture and maintenance of mechanical systems. Students Studying Mechanical Engineering in Spain also get to experience the real-world use of engineering principles in today's industries.

items: Hands-on engineering education: Learn about machine design, materials, thermodynamics, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
Laboratory-based learning: Experience the engineering equipment, simulations, workshops and technical projects where possible.
Industrial applications: Think automotive manufacturing, aerospace, energy, industrial machinery and production systems.
Modern technologies: Learn about robotics, automation, computer-aided design (CAD) and computer-aided engineering (CAE).
European academic exposure: Experience the Spanish university system and international study opportunities.
Further education: Continue to specialized master's programs in mechanical engineering, automotive engineering, robotics or energy systems.

sections.title: Study Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering in Spain Requirements
sections.lead: Generally, Indian students applying for an undergraduate degree must satisfy the following requirements:

items: 12th Class Qualification: 12th Class passed from recognized board.
Mathematics and Physics: These subjects are particularly important, and may be required for admission.
Academic grades: Satisfy the university's admission and selection criteria.
Qualification recognition: Submit the foreign qualification evaluation or university admission process.
Requirements in Spanish, Catalan or English: Satisfy the program requirements in Spanish, Catalan or English.
Other admission requirements: Complete any entrance exams, pre-enrolment procedures or credential assessments required by the institution.
Public universities are highly competitive. Meeting minimum eligibility requirements does not ensure admission.

sections.title: Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering in Spain Requirements
sections.lead: The requirements vary from university to university, but generally students need to have:

items: Class 10 and Class 12 mark sheet and certificate.
Academic transcripts with subjects and grades.

In Spain most mechanical engineering courses are taught in either Spanish or Catalan. Some programs may feature subjects taught in English, so applicants should check the language of instruction for the whole degree before applying.

sections.title: Spain Mechanical Engineering Tuition Fees
sections.lead: Understanding Mechanical Engineering Fees in Spain is essential for estimating the total cost of an undergraduate degree. Tuition fees depend on the university, the region, the number of credits and the fee category of international students.

items: Type of universityExample annual tuitionApprox. INR per year
Public university€1,000 - €8,000₹1.09 - ₹8.69 lakh
Private University€6,000-€20,000+₹6.52-₹21.72 Lakh+
These are planning estimates not guarantyd fees for any university. Please check the non-EU tuition fee for your chosen course and year of study.
Examples of university tuition fees:
UPC, Terrassa: Its Mechanical Engineering degree costs around €1,800 (approximately ₹1.95 lakh) per year for non-EU residents.

UPV, Alcoy: The Mechanical Engineering degree will cost €17.34 per credit in the academic year. This amounts to approximately €1,040 (around ₹1.13 lakh) for 60 credits, excluding other charges and subject to fee conditions.

Students should also have a separate budget for accommodation, food, transport, health insurance, books, visa fees and other personal expenses. Scholarships and/or fee waivers may be available based on eligibility and university rules.
Conversions are provided using an example rate of €1 ≈ ₹108.60. Rates are subject to change.

sections.title: How to apply to a Bachelor degree in Mechanical Engineering in Spain
sections.lead: Students who want to Study Mechanical Engineering in Spain can follow the below steps:

items: Choose your specialization: Are you interested in machine design, manufacturing, automotive systems, mechatronics or energy engineering?
Shortlist universities: Compare course curriculum, fees, language of instruction, labs and admission requirements.
Check that your qualification is accepted: Confirm that the Spanish university you are applying to accepts the Indian Class 12 qualification.
Prepare your documents: Academic certificates, transcripts, passport details, language test results if required.
Follow the right application process: Apply through the university or regional pre-enrolment system, if relevant.
Additional requirements fulfilled: Provide any additional documents or complete any assessments requested by the institution.
Accept admission and finances: Review your offer, tuition deadlines, and scholarship requirements.
Student Visa Application: Follow latest Spain Student Visa Requirements for Indian Applicants.
Prepare to enrol: Arrange accommodation, travel, insurance and university enrollment.
University and regional admission deadlines vary. Begin early, especially if your academic credentials require additional recognition, translation or verification.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide can help students in understanding the process of the university selection, application requirements and important steps of admission.

sections.title: Recognition of the Mechanical Engineering Degree from Spain
sections.lead: Indian students must verify that the qualification selected is apt for their academic and career aspirations before enrolling.

items: Some important things to consider:
If the university and the degree are officially recognized in Spain.
If the course is an official Bachelor's degree.
Admission to the master's program you want to study in.
Whether the degree is intended to qualify graduates for a regulated engineering profession.
If you need additional professional recognition in the country where you plan to work.

Some Spanish engineering degrees in mechanical engineering are eligible to practice in some regulated industrial engineering professions. The UPV considers its Mechanical Engineering degree to be a qualifying program. UPC also considers some engineering degrees, such as the Vilanova i la Geltrú program, to be valid for access to the regulated profession of Technical Industrial Engineer. Check the exact professional status of the degree you select.

If you are planning to return to India, check the recognition requirements for your intended role with relevant Indian authorities, employers or professional bodies. In each country, a foreign engineering degree does not automatically confer the same professional rights.

faqs.q: Can Indian students study Mechanical Engineering in Spain after class 12?
faqs.a: Yes. Indian students can apply after Class 12, provided they meet the academic, subject, qualification-recognition, language and university admission requirements.

faqs.q: How long is a Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering in Spain?
faqs.a: Most bachelor programs are four years, awarding students 240 ECTS credits.

faqs.q: Does Mechanical Engineering in Spain require IELTS?
faqs.a: Not always. English-taught programs may require IELTS, TOEFL or an accepted alternative. Students may need to know Spanish or Catalan if the programs are offered in these languages. Before you apply, check the language requirements for the full degree.

faqs.q: How much does a Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering cost in Spain?
faqs.a: General planning assumptions suggest tuition fees at public universities could range from €1,000 to €8,000 a year, while private universities may be more expensive. Actual fees depend on the university, program and the international student fee category. Check out the current Fees for Mechanical Engineering in Spain before you set your budget.

faqs.q: What are the job opportunities after Mechanical Engineering Bachelors in Spain?
faqs.a: Graduates can find employment in the fields of automotive engineering, machine design, manufacturing, robotics, industrial systems, energy, maintenance and product development. Some specialist or senior posts may require postgraduate qualifications or professional experience.
